root_rule: only a source observation whose source_hash matches the case source identity is a lineage root without an authority-conferring basis
recursive_rule: every authority-conferring dependency receipt must be recomputed recursively from its producer ceiling, exact bounds, explicit authority-conferring basis, dependencies, and source identity; status=established is never sufficient
cycle_rule: any dependency cycle invalidates the lineage
resolution_rule: a blocking conflict/residue is discharged only by a recursively valid resolution receipt whose basis domain=resolution operation=resolve and whose resolves_ids explicitly contains that exact id
preservation_rule: raw source, proposals, conflicts, residues, comparison receipts, and rejected/unresolved alternatives remain unchanged in the returned evidence snapshot
